Estimated items on the tray:
- 2 poached eggs: about 140 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 10 g fat
- 2 grilled tomato halves: about 25 kcal, 1 g protein, 5 g carbs, 0.5 g fat
- 1 banana: about 105 kcal, 1 g protein, 27 g carbs, 0.4 g fat
- Greek yogurt pot (about 100 g): about 90 kcal, 5 g protein, 5 g carbs, 5 g fat
- 2 slices of sourdough toast: about 200 kcal, 7 g protein, 40 g carbs, 1.5 g fat
- Orange juice (about 200 ml): about 90 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0.3 g fat
- Tea: about 5 kcal
- Butter or spread: none visible

Served total is about 655 kcal.

I assumed some leftovers, since people rarely finish everything: about 10% of the toast and tomato, and some of the yogurt, which comes to about 50 kcal. That leaves about 605 kcal eaten.

Eaten macros are about 27 g protein, 95 g carbs and 16 g fat.
